In this episode I take a simple idea that’s been stuck in my head and test it in the real world. I try to recreate a high paying hole in one style business using a disc golf challenge, charging a small entry fee for a chance to win big. Along the way we run into setbacks, get kicked out of a park, adjust the rules, and still gather real data on probability, risk, and pricing. By the end I break down why this kind of game of skill business actually works, how to think about the math behind it, and how you could turn challenges like this into a legit, low cost business with the right setup.

Enjoy!
